text: Book Chapter called **"Natural Language Processing of Clinical Data"** is published in the book **Springer Handbook of Data Engineering**, *Springer Nature*.
Completed my M.S. in Computer Science at George Mason University.
Our paper [MasonNLP at MEDIQA-SYNUR 2026](https://doi.org/10.63317/2xwjn5f2urna) appeared at the 8th Clinical NLP Workshop @ LREC 2026.
Serving on the program committee of the [8th Clinical NLP Workshop](https://clinical-nlp.github.io/2026/).
Book chapter *Natural Language Processing of Clinical Data* to appear in the Springer Handbook of Data Engineering.

Two MEDIQA papers published at the 7th Clinical NLP Workshop @ ACL 2025: [medical VQA](https://aclanthology.org/2025.clinicalnlp-1.10/) and [medical order extraction](https://aclanthology.org/2025.clinicalnlp-1.7/).
Our Bangla intent detection and slot filling paper was presented at [CHiPSAL @ COLING 2025](https://aclanthology.org/2025.chipsal-1.21/) in Abu Dhabi.
